I need to decide on an auction bid for North Carolina Avenue.

The current bid of $57 is well below the $150 cap. I will raise to the minimum $58.

Mortgaging North Carolina Avenue immediately after winning would return $150, giving a net gain of $92. This blocks p4 from completing a green monopoly.

Blocking p4 from North Carolina Avenue does not actually prevent a green monopoly, since Pacific Avenue is owned by p1. The strategic value of this block is limited.

The immediate cash arbitrage is the main driver. Paying $58 leaves $668, and mortgaging returns $150 for a net gain of $92. This profit is independent of strategic value.

Boardwalk with four houses costs $1700. Park Place with three houses costs $1100. I currently have $726 cash plus house equity from my red properties.

I can raise roughly $900 by selling my red houses back at half price. The $58 bid is far below the $150 cap, so I will keep bidding the minimum and not jump. p4 has $763 cash and may be trying to acquire North Carolina Avenue as a trade chip with p1 for Pacific Avenue.
